key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 prompting immediate coastal evacuations
Approximately 80% of residents in surveyed barangays evacuated after the alert
No significant tsunami wave appeared and no damages were observed
Communication issues during the alert included power cuts and mobile network problems
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred in the Philippine Trench east of Eastern Samar
PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3 including coastal areas of Eastern Samar and Leyte
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of residents evacuating; no damages were observed
missing_information: Detailed shaking impact locations and intensities by municipality not itemized
